name: Rego Center
summary: Rego Center is a popular Queens shopping destination featuring major value retailers including Costco, Century 21, Marshalls, and Burlington, along with casual dining options. The open-air center serves as a convenient one-stop shopping hub for families and bargain-seekers throughout the borough.
demographics: Rego Center attracts a diverse, middle-class demographic reflective of the surrounding Rego Park and Forest Hills neighborhoods in Queens. The primary trade area serves families with household incomes ranging from $60,000 to $120,000, including a significant mix of young professionals, established families, and multi-generational households. The center draws heavily from Queens' ethnically diverse population, with strong representation from Asian, Hispanic, and Eastern European communities who appreciate the value-oriented anchor stores like Costco, Marshalls, and Burlington. Shoppers typically seek convenient one-stop shopping for everyday needs, combining grocery runs with apparel and home goods purchases, with weekend traffic particularly strong among family groups.
description: Rego Center stands as a prominent shopping destination in the heart of Queens, New York, serving the vibrant communities of Rego Park, Forest Hills, and surrounding neighborhoods. Located at 61-35 Junction Boulevard, this open-air shopping center has established itself as a go-to location for value-conscious shoppers seeking quality merchandise from trusted national retailers. The center's anchor tenant lineup features powerhouse retailers including Costco Wholesale, Century 21 Department Store, Marshalls, and Burlington, creating a compelling mix that draws shoppers from across Queens and beyond. Beyond its strong retail foundation, Rego Center offers visitors a variety of casual dining options, making it easy to combine shopping with a meal or quick bite. With convenient access from major thoroughfares and ample parking, the center has maintained its position as a community hub where families can accomplish multiple shopping tasks in one trip, from stocking up on groceries and household essentials to finding deals on clothing and home furnishings.
